title: Generator collection (generator-library.json)
description: A repository that holds several generators, such as a monorepo with apps/*. Each entry is an inline generator manifest or a pointer to a generator.json inside the repository.

defaults.description: Fields applied to every generator unless it sets its own. Tags are merged.

path.description: Path of a generator.json inside the repository, e.g. apps/clicker-generator/generator.json
